name: visisign-backend
description: VisiSign backend — data layer, business logic and secure REST API. Runs on SQLite (on-premise) or PostgreSQL (cloud).
//: Photo storage beyond a local folder needs ONE extra package, installed only
if you use it — the modules require it lazily and say so if it is missing:
They are deliberately not listed as dependencies: each is tens of megabytes,
and the on-premise build never touches object storage.
SQLite needs nothing: node:sqlite is built into Node 22.5+.
